title: Exchange Rate, Productivity and Exports: The Case of Indian Textile Sector

summary.about: Examines how exchange rates, prices and productivity influence Indian textile and apparel exports.
summary.audience: Textile exporters, monetary policymakers and trade economists.
summary.method: Uses long-run cointegration, Granger causality, impulse responses and variance decomposition on historical data. The empirical design separates long-run equilibrium relationships from short-run adjustment and dynamic response.
summary.insights: Exchange rates and export prices have clear long-run links to exports; productivity’s role is present but less conclusive. The estimated relationships should be interpreted as model-based associations unless a stronger identification strategy is specified.
